name: Samvardhana Motherson
title: Investor Presentation on the unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

read.thesis: Record H1 revenue of Rs 73,524 Cr (+22%) led by acquisitions and wiring harness, but Q2 margin fell to 8.8% and capex of Rs 1,971 Cr (59% of EBITDA) is running well inside the Rs 6,000 Cr FY27 guide.

capex.quote: Capex spend well within the reduced guidance for the year

triggers.label: Capex Rs 1,971 Cr, 59% of EBITDA
triggers.quote: Capex of Rs. 1,971 Crores (59% of EBITDA)

triggers.label: Booked business USD 106 Bn all-time high
triggers.quote: Strong Booked Business of USD 106 billion*All-time high

triggers.label: Q2 EBITDA margin 8.8% vs 9.0%
triggers.quote: Margins declined on account of integration of newly acquired assets

guidance.quote: Capex guidance for FY27 is Rs. 6,000 Cr (+/-10%)

prior_guidance_check.quote: Capex in-line with growth priorities and yearly guidance

red_flags.label: Q2 margin down YoY on integration
red_flags.quote: Margins declined on account of integration of newly acquired assets

red_flags.label: MPP demand muted
red_flags.quote: MPP: Muted Demand; Cost Optimization supports Margins.

growth.why: No revenue or EBITDA growth guidance given; management reiterated FY27 capex of Rs 6,000 Cr (+/-10%) and 0.8x net leverage, and cited a record USD 106 billion booked business, which is order-book backing rather than specific capacity with timing.
